object.description: Setup: a saved workout with splits, route, heart rate readings and a note; a way to read the database (adb run-as with sqlite3). Steps: 1. Count the rows for the workout in all tables. 2. Open the workout, select delete, cancel; check it is still listed. 3. Select delete and confirm. 4. Count the rows again. Expected: After cancelling nothing changes; after confirming the count is 0 in every table and the workout is not listed in History.
